paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
No Hurricane Ida (Sept 2021) high-water marks were surveyed within 800 meters of 79-01 Broadway, Queens; the nearest surveyed mark was 1126 meters away [ida_hwm].

**Hazard Reader.**
This address sits outside the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint (NYC OEM) [sandy_inundation]. This address sits in FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970207F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. This address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR) [dep_moderate_2050].

**Live Observer.**
2 FloodNet community sensor(s) within 600 meters have logged 1 above-curb flood event(s) in the last 3 years. Peak depth recorded by these sensors: 14 mm [floodnet]. 20 NYC 311 flood-related complaints were filed within 200 meters of this location in the last 5 years. Most common descriptor: Sewer Backup (Use Comments) (SA) [nyc311].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
